title: LinkedIn Company Profile Input
description: Pull structured company facts from any LinkedIn company page without a cookie or login. Paste company URLs and run.

companyUrls.title: Company URLs
companyUrls.description: List of LinkedIn company URLs whose profile facts you want to scrape. Examples: 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft/', 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/openai/'. School and showcase pages are also accepted.

includeLocations.title: Include locations
includeLocations.description: Pull every office location LinkedIn lists for the company. Each location ships nested on the company row.

includeSpecialties.title: Include specialties
includeSpecialties.description: Pull the company's self declared specialty tags. Useful for industry classification and lookalike search.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of companies processed in parallel. Higher concurrency runs faster but increases proxy and detection risk. Six is a safe default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for LinkedIn at any meaningful volume.
